messages:
jessica_pm: Quick sync — finalizing GA criteria for the new Predict API v2. Need signoff on SLA tiers, docs scope (hosted/dedicated/private), oncall/runbooks, and pricing SKUs. Can owners confirm gaps by EOD?

arjun_eng: Quick notes from infra: we can confidently hit p95 latency targets for small models (p95 token gen <= 150ms) on hosted. p99 for large models is still noisy due to cold starts and cross-region routing.

maria_docs: Docs note: I'm drafting a single-page GA quickstart + migration guide. Will include separate examples for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private (VPC). Need the final SLA numbers + CLI flags to land examples. PR by 3pm.

kevin_sre: Oncall/runbooks: agree we need explicit runbook for model fallback + region failover. Propose weekend rotation for the first 4 weeks post-GA. Also need a clear traffic-throttle + auto-fallback policy in the runbook.

sophie_finops: Pricing POV: recommend two SKUs at GA — Standard (metered hosted) and Reserved (dedicated capacity commit). We should publish a simple per-token delta and a migration credit for early adopters. I'll draft numbers but need confirmed latency SLO buckets.

arjun_eng: Actionable: I'll add model-variant fallback configs (e.g., quantized fallback) and a small test harness to measure cold-start p99. Also need to decide if p95 SLOs relax for requests >1k tokens — we could use a separate long-tail SLO.

jessica_pm: Proposal: keep latency SLOs split by model-class (small/medium/large) and token-length buckets (<256, 256-1024, >1024). Owners: @arjun_eng SLA + infra, @maria_docs docs, @kevin_sre oncall/runbooks, @sophie_finops pricing. Please ack + call out any blockers.

kevin_sre: Ack. Blocker: need console controls for throttling thresholds before GA; otherwise runbook will be manual. Can product prioritize a small UI control?

maria_docs: Ack. Blocker for docs: need exact CLI/SDK flags for cache TTL and batch settings to show recommended configs for cost/latency tradeoffs.

sophie_finops: Ack. I'll upload a pricing table draft to the shared doc and mark open items for model-class deltas.

arjun_eng: Ack. I'll post the fallback config and failure-sim script in #eng-runtime by 2pm; will include suggested p95/p99 per bucket.

oncall_bot: Reminder: runbook link required to oncall rota before 2024-10-01.

jessica_pm: Thanks — if no unaddressed blockers by EOD, we'll mark the GA checklist as "ready for exec signoff" tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

(threads like this should stay short — follow-ups can go to #eng-runtime or a dedicated doc.)
